records.real_world_identity_notes: This is the Chevrolet Cruze-bodied entry in the 2023 Brazilian Stock Car Pro Series, not a road Chevrolet Cruze. The category used a common purpose-built Stock Car chassis and standardized platform components; the GM make annex identifies the Chevrolet Cruze body and construction for the 2023 edition.

records.specification_basis: The Article 13.2 gear-pair table assigns six forward gears to the permitted X-TRAC 396B023 transmission. This supports the project's semi-automatic category, but does not establish internal dog-ring versus synchromesh construction. The regulation requires the semi-automatic paddle-shift actuation system.
